description: Add, revise, or remove recurring date anchors on contacts or links. Use this for birthdays, anniversaries, and yearly events — not manage_attribute.

inputSchema.description: Add, revise, or remove recurring date anchors.

anchorEventId.description: Anchor event id. Required when action=revise or remove.

input.description: Date anchor payload. Required when action=add.

now.description: Optional timestamp override. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.

contact.description: Contact locator. Required when kind=contact. Provide contactId or identity.

link.description: Link locator. Required when kind=link. Provide linkId or endpoints.

force.description: Whether duplicate checks should be bypassed.

now.description: Optional timestamp. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.

removedAt.description: Removal timestamp. Optional for action=remove. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.

name: manage_date_anchor
